applicable_when: The kernel has xnumel=9 (only 9 elements in X) but XBLOCK=128, meaning 119 out of 128 X-threads are masked off and do no work — a 93% waste in the X dimension. The grid is (1, 7168): 1 block in X, 7168 blocks in Y. With 132 SMs this creates 3 full waves + a partial wave of 7168 mod 132 = 833 blocks, causing up to 25% tail latency. The fix is to collapse X into Y, use a flat 1D tiling with autotuned BLOCK_SIZE covering all 57344*9=516096 elements. This eliminates wasted threads, reduces the grid from 7168 blocks to 127-505 blocks, and minimizes the partial-wave tail on 132 SMs.
